previous.description: Command-line companion for Kronikol. Includes `kronikol merge`, which combines several mergeable TestRunReport.json files (produced with GenerateMergeableData enabled — e.g. by parallel CI runners) into a single combined TestRunReport.html; `kronikol ingest`, which replays language-neutral NDJSON interaction captures (from an out-of-process proxy tap or any non-.NET capturer) into a full Kronikol report; `kronikol query`, which answers questions about a TestRunReport.json — why a test failed, what a service returned, where a wrong value came from — without loading the file, so a 10 MB report is debuggable by tooling and by AI agents; and `kronikol export`, which pushes NDJSON interaction captures to an OTLP/HTTP collector as OpenTelemetry spans so the traffic only Kronikol saw appears in Tempo/Jaeger next to the app's real traces.

current.description: Command-line companion for Kronikol. Includes `kronikol merge`, which combines several mergeable TestRunReport.json files (produced with GenerateMergeableData enabled — e.g. by parallel CI runners) into a single combined TestRunReport.html plus the merged TestRunReport.json beside it, so a sharded run is queryable and can serve as a baseline; `kronikol ingest`, which replays language-neutral NDJSON interaction captures (from an out-of-process proxy tap or any non-.NET capturer) into a full Kronikol report; `kronikol query`, which answers questions about a TestRunReport.json — why a test failed, what a service returned, where a wrong value came from — without loading the file, so a 10 MB report is debuggable by tooling and by AI agents; `kronikol export`, which pushes NDJSON interaction captures to an OTLP/HTTP collector as OpenTelemetry spans so the traffic only Kronikol saw appears in Tempo/Jaeger next to the app's real traces; `kronikol ctrf`, which converts a TestRunReport.json into a Common Test Report Format document so CI tooling that already speaks CTRF can read a Kronikol run; and `kronikol init-agents`, which installs the test-debugging skill and the CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md instruction block into an existing repository, so its agents know the report is there and how to read it.

A .NET library for defining, managing, and editing data structure schemas with a rich type system, type-safe identifiers, and polymorphic JSON serialization. Define structured data models programmatically or visually and serialize them to .schema.json files, providing a metadata foundation for code generation, data validation, and tooling that needs to reason about your data structures. Ships with an accompanying Dear ImGui desktop editor for visual schema authoring.
